texts.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这一发现确认了我们长久以来的怀疑——我们在星辰之间并不孤单。新的外星物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须保持警惕。

这些外星人的科技水平与我们类似，表明他们可能和我们大概在同一时期实现了太空旅行。
texts.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.

These particular xenos have a level of technology similar to our own, indicating that we achieved space flight at roughly the same time.

texts.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命的初次相遇的新闻在[Root.GetName]如野火般扩散开来。人们为此十分着迷，媒体充满了对其文化与组织形式的报导和推测。“我们在宇宙中并不孤单”这一真相引起了[Root.Capital.GetName]人民的欢呼。

和我们一样，这些外星人似乎也才刚刚登上星系的舞台，他们的科技水平与我们类似。
texts.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The revelation that we are not alone in this galaxy has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Just like us, the aliens appear to be relative newcomers on the galactic stage and their level of technology is similar to our own.

texts.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻在整个帝国产生了动乱。这些奇怪生物的录像泄露到了[Root.GetName]的媒体并迅速传播开来，许多人陷入了巨大的恐慌。[Root.Capital.GetName]数个城市发生了不安定事件。

这些奇怪外星人的科技水平似乎与我们类似，他们明显能够进行太空旅行。他们对我们这一伟大种群的态度是恐惧、仇恨还是冷漠，则无人知晓。
texts.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The strange xenos appear to have achieved a level of technology similar to our own, and they are clearly spacefaring. Whether they regard our great species with fear, hatred or cold indifference is anyone's guess.

texts.zh:
我们的理论模型早就指出星系中有其他智慧文明存在。现在这一理论已被证实。

我们遭遇的这个外星种群拥有和我们相近的科技水平，说明他们实现太空航行的时间与我们大致相同。
texts.en:
Our theoretical models have long suggested the existence of other intelligent civilizations in our galaxy. This theory has now been confirmed.

The alien political entity that we have encountered has a level of technology similar to our own, indicating that we achieved space flight at roughly the same time.

texts.zh:
寂静的太空对我们的呼唤做出了回应！这个与我们科技水平相当的外星文明，他们一定和我们在差不多的时候踏上了星海的征途。

他们的出现引领着一个全新的体验前言。他们会成为志趣相投的盟友，或是磨炼勇气的试金石？无论如何，未知的刺激正在召唤着我们前进。
texts.en:
Out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! An alien civilization with equivalent technology. They must have entered the galactic fray right around the time we did.

Their appearance heralds a new frontier of experience. Do they come as like minded allies, or rivals to test our mettle? Either way, the thrill of the unknown beckons us forward.

label.zh: 我们应该做好最坏的打算。

texts.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这一发现确认了我们长久以来的怀疑——我们在星系并不孤单。新的外星物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须保持警惕。

这些外星人似乎在星系舞台上十分活跃——貌似已有千年之久，科技水平远在我们之上。我们必须十分小心。
texts.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.

These particular xenos appear to have been active on the galactic stage for some time - their empire is likely thousands of years old, and their technology is far ahead of our own. We should be careful when dealing with them.

texts.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命的初次相遇的新闻在[Root.GetName]如野火般扩散开来。人们为此十分着迷，媒体充满了对其文化和组织形式的报告和推测。“我们在星系并不孤单”这一真相引起了[Root.Capital.GetName]人民的欢呼。

这些外星人帝国似乎非常古老，他们的科技水平远在我们之上，一定可以教给我们许多知识。
texts.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The revelation that we are not alone in this galaxy has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The empire these aliens have founded appears to be very old, and their level of technology is far ahead of our own. There is no doubt a great deal they could teach us.

texts.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命的初次相遇的新闻在整个帝国产生了动乱。这些奇怪生物的录像泄露到了[Root.GetName]的媒体并迅速传播开来，许多人陷入了巨大的恐慌。[Root.Capital.GetName]数个城市发生了不安定事件。

那些奇怪的外星人已发展出远高于我们的科技，似乎在几千年前就实现了空间旅行——可能还要更久。幸运的是，他们似乎是一个衰老与停滞的种群。
texts.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The strange xenos have achieved a level of technology far beyond our own, and they appear to have been spacefaring for thousands of years - possibly even longer. Fortunately for us, their kind appear to be a decrepit and stagnating species.

texts.zh:
我们的理论模型早就指出星系中有其他智慧文明存在。现在这一理论已被证实。

我们遭遇的这个外星政治实体似乎很古老，拥有远超我们的科技水平。需小心对待。
texts.en:
Our theoretical models have long suggested the existence of other intelligent civilizations in our galaxy. This theory has now been confirmed.

The alien political entity that we have encountered appears to be an old one, possessing technology that is far advanced of our own. Caution is advised.

texts.zh: 从寂静的太空中，我们的呼唤得到了回应！但第一印象不太对劲，这些人和我们想法不同，他们更喜欢保守自己的秘密。我们目前最好保持距离。
texts.en: From out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! But the initial vibes are totally off; these people don't share our ways, and prefer to keep to themselves. We'd best back off for now.

label.zh: 他们的智慧一定非常伟大。
他们的时代已经结束。[Root.Species.GetName]的时代即将来临。
label.en: Their age is over. The time of the [Root.Species.GetName] has come.
They should get with the times.
